description: Revoke a client-connect link before it has been used. Idempotent; an account it already connected is untouched. Pro and Business only: on the single-seat Free and Lifetime plans this answers 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with the plan and an upgrade hint. Use this when the user wants to stop a client-connect link from working before it has been used. Any account it already connected is unaffected.
name: delete_client_connect_link
title: Revoke client connect link
